lines.en: I trot along over the loose stones.
The red earth of the badlands is hot underfoot.
I walk in the shade of the ridge.
Four of us, spread out.
I keep my head down hunting bugs in the cracks.
There is very little grass here.

lines.zh: 我小跑两步，跟上前面那只。
lines.en: I trot two steps to keep up.
A stone rolls away under my foot.
I shake out my feathers as I walk.
I duck my head against a gust.

lines.zh: 沙地上我的爪子印很细。
lines.en: My prints in the sand are fine.

lines.zh: 我踩在碎石上，声音很脆。
lines.en: The scree crunches under my feet.

lines.zh: 一只同伴跑到前面去了。
lines.en: A herd-mate has run ahead.
I veer around a block of red sandstone.
I stand, head darting in and out.
Nothing stirs around me.
I scratch my neck with a hind claw.
A herd-mate pecks nearby.
I lower my beak too.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出很轻的声音。
lines.en: A soft sound comes from my throat.
These badlands are very empty.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿理顺羽毛。
lines.en: I lift a leg to smooth my feathers.
Sand swirls at my feet.
The others bunch together.
I rest on a flat stone.
Small insects crawl in the sand.
I peck once and miss.

lines.zh: 我的名字是偷蛋的，可我只吃素。
lines.en: My name means egg thief, but I eat plants.
You came down the slope.
I saw your shadow first.
You are very tall.
I tilt my head and study your hands.
My herd-mates backed up too.
We cannot fight you.
But we can run.
Your boots are covered in sand.
You must have come a long way.
I watch your hands, not your face.
You are standing upwind.
I cannot smell you.
I cry out on a high note.
Every herd-mate looks up.
Behind the rock, just for a moment.
This leg of mine is lame.
My feathers puffed out in a ring.
My tail has drooped to the ground.
I stand on one leg.
The other is tucked up.
I spring a short way off.
A few feathers remain on the ground.
Is that leaves in your hand?
Or some other leaf?
I cannot make out what it is.
Lower it further.
You dangle it up high.
My neck is not long enough.
That thing in your hand is too small.
Not enough for four of us.

lines.zh: 你手上那点东西不够看。
lines.en: What you hold is not worth a look.
I prefer to find my own.
You stepped on my claw.
I let out a shrill cry.
The little herd scattered.
They came back after a while.
You squeeze past my side.
I spring to the side.
My feathers all stood up.
My claw is under your foot.
I pulled once and it would not come.
You lifted your foot and I ran.
There are only a few of us in this group.
That is not for me.
We know each other by scent.
These matters are settled outside the group.
I cannot answer what you ask.
We think only of eating enough.

lines.zh: 这是要一起待一季的事。
lines.en: It is a thing for a whole season.
It is far too early yet.
I did not choose my herd-mates.
Nobody in this herd answers that.
The thing on the ground is very small.
I have to take it in my beak.
I pick it up and drop it.
It is caught on my claw.
I shake it hard twice.
It came off.
I clutch this egg and back away.
Still it will not hold.
It is wider than my head.
It rolled into a crack.
Your steps make the stones ring.
I heard those sounds.
We head for the ridge.
There are rocks to hide behind.
Do not come chasing.
We can run a long while.
We have scattered.

lines.zh: 你看得见一个，看不见四个。
lines.en: You can see one, not four.
There is no cover on the sand.
That is why we run.
You are only one.
We have four directions.

lines.zh: 你追一个，其他三个就跑。
lines.en: Chase one and the other three run.
I paused a moment.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刨起一串碎石。
lines.en: My claws kick up a spray of gravel.

lines.zh: 你和我们之间还有一段。
lines.en: There is still a stretch between us.
My herd-mates are ahead.
They will stop and wait for me.
I will not run forever.
My breathing is still even.
Yours has grown heavy.
The shadow of the ridge is long.
I watch you from behind a rock.
You do not know how many there are.
We went around the big stone.
You came on from the other side.
Now we are behind you.
We will not come close.
We only follow, nothing more.

lines.zh: 你跟不上我们换方向的速度。
lines.en: You cannot match how fast we turn.
I retreated to the edge of a ravine.
I hop up and peck once.
It was as light as a touch.
You did not give half a step.
I hop up and peck at your belt.
This time on your knuckle.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面窜到你侧面。
lines.en: I dash low along the ground to your flank.

lines.zh: 爪子在你裤腿上划了一道。
lines.en: My claws score your trouser leg.
I run the moment I land.
I peck and pull away.
My legs are quicker than your hands.
I spring up, claws first.
Your shin is caught.
My beak stabs at your hand.
Then one more.
You guard your face; your legs are open.
I leap and land back where I was.
We come out of a rock crevice.
The sand still holds last night's cool.
Four of us; I am at the back.
The sun is up.
We head for lower ground.
The hot badlands wind hits me first.

lines.zh: 恶地的地面裂成一条一条。
lines.en: The badland floor is split into strips.
We walk along the cracks.

lines.zh: 风把沙粒吹进我的羽毛。
lines.en: Wind drives sand into my feathers.
We shake out our feathers.
These badlands are bleached pale.
We stand in the shade.
The sun climbs higher.
I slid down the slope.
The sand came down with me.
All four of us are here.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的羽毛，我跳开。
lines.en: Fire singes my feathers and I spring away.
I slide down the ridge.
Water fills my mouth; I kick wildly.

lines.zh: 沙被掀起来，我跌了一跤。
lines.en: Sand sprays up and I tumble.
Something sharp went into my leg.
That light makes my legs fail.
Too little grass; I walk slower and slower.
Lightning strikes and the sand blackens.
The sand beneath me is gone.
